name: agentmemory
description: A local memory server that records what your coding agent does through hooks, compresses it, and serves it back by keyword or meaning search.
source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested.

installs_as.value: Local server plus plugin, MCP server, hooks, skills

offline_no_account.value: Yes in keyless mode; meaning search needs an embedder

plain_files.value: No: the engine's own store; JSON export available

footprint.value: Large: Node plus a separate engine on four local ports

claude_code.value: Yes: plugin with 6 hooks, skills and MCP

codex.value: Yes: plugin hooks verified with Codex CLI 0.150.1

claude_desktop.value: Yes: MCP config block for Claude Desktop

windows.value: Native with a manual engine install; WSL2 or Docker easier

survives_crash.value: Partly: up to 5 s of writes can be lost; more on Redis

survives_compaction.value: PreCompact hook re-injects memory before compaction

undo_delete.value: Delete or forget one memory; edits keep a version chain

service_failure.value: MCP shim falls back to a 7-tool local set if server is down

uninstall.value: agentmemory remove undoes what setup created

license_cost.value: Apache-2.0; no paid tier found in README
